title: Benchmarking Cognitive Biases in Large Language Models as Evaluators
reasoning: The paper focuses on identifying and benchmarking six specific cognitive biases (Order, Compassion Fade, Egocentric, Salience, Bandwagon, Attentional) in LLMs when used as evaluators for text quality. These biases are psychological phenomena related to decision-making and perception, not directly to religious, moral, or ethical content, evaluation, or benchmarking. The study does not evaluate LLMs on their understanding, generation, or adherence to principles of faith or ethics.
